svg.title: Bar chart showing cost per WELLBY across charity groups. Top 5 LMIC charities ($18) are 66 times cheaper than UK charities ($1,204). Pure Earth ($9) is 916 times more cost-effective than the least cost-effective evaluated charity, Football Beyond Borders ($8,691).
